themes.title: Enterprise AI infrastructure converts to revenue
themes.thesis: Cloud growth is the clearest current proof point: focus on whether AI infrastructure demand persists while returns stay above the cost of incremental capacity.

themes.title: Distribution turns models into product economics
themes.thesis: Installed workflows and consumer ecosystems are the highest-quality path from model capability to recurring revenue and retention.

themes.title: Consumer IP still needs repeatability
themes.thesis: For Pop Mart, the next underwriting question is whether global demand broadens across IPs and regions rather than relying on one breakout franchise.
